name: Thermex-G4
description: A graphene-based anisotropic thermal management layer engineered by Apex Nanofabrication for precision heat spreading and directional thermal conductivity. Thermex-G4 is manufactured as a thin composite sheet — typically 0.3mm to 1.2mm — with graphene planes aligned to channel heat laterally at rates exceeding copper while remaining thermally resistive in the perpendicular axis. It is bonded to heat-generating components using a nano-adhesive interface that eliminates contact resistance.
applications: processor and compute core cooling in high-density data stacks
story_hooks: Thermex-G4 is going missing from Apex Nanofabrication's supply chain in small enough quantities to avoid automated audit flags — someone is diverting it to build illegal high-power directed energy hardware.
A Tier 3 technician discovers that inferior thermal paste knockoffs are being sold in Thermex-G4 packaging, causing cascading compute failures across a district's shared infrastructure nodes.
Military-grade Thermex-G4 variants capable of handling reactor-adjacent heat loads have appeared in civilian markets, suggesting a serious breach in restricted material distribution.
